desktop.update.downloadDetail.zh:
正在下载更新：{percent}%
目标版本：V{version}

desktop.update.checkFailed.en: Could not check for updates. Please try again later.
desktop.update.checkFailed.zh: 检查更新失败，请稍后重试。

desktop.update.downloadFailed.en: Could not download the update. Please try again.

desktop.update.installFailed.en: Could not install the update. Please try again later.
desktop.update.installFailed.zh: 安装更新失败，请稍后重试。

desktop.update.checkNetworkFailed.en: Could not check for updates. Please try again later. The connection was interrupted. Check your network and try again.
desktop.update.checkNetworkFailed.zh: 检查更新失败，请稍后重试。网络连接异常，请检查网络后重试。

desktop.update.downloadNetworkFailed.en: Could not download the update. Please try again. The connection was interrupted. Check your network and try again.
desktop.update.downloadNetworkFailed.zh: 下载更新失败，请重试。网络连接异常，请检查网络后重试。

desktop.update.installNetworkFailed.en: Could not install the update. Please try again later. The connection was interrupted. Check your network and try again.
desktop.update.installNetworkFailed.zh: 安装更新失败，请稍后重试。网络连接异常，请检查网络后重试。

desktop.update.stopFailed.en: Tasks could not be stopped safely. The update was not installed. Please try again later.
desktop.update.stopFailed.zh: 未能安全停止任务，更新未安装。请稍后重试。

desktop.update.tasksChanged.en: New tasks started. Review the update confirmation again.
desktop.update.tasksChanged.zh: 有新任务开始，请重新确认更新。

desktop.update.tasksUnavailable.en: Task status is unavailable. Try updating again when the workspace is ready.
desktop.update.tasksUnavailable.zh: 无法确认任务状态，请在工作区就绪后重试更新。

connection.reconnect.zh: 连接异常，点击立即重连

connection.restart.zh: 连接中断，正在重试，点击立即重连
